source_contract: AndroidPhysicalMouseCapture.LogCapturedActions emits pressMask/releaseMask and v/h callback counters. PhysicalMouseLegacyReaderEvidence.Report emits 11 slots held/down/up 0..2 plus scrollAxis and scrollVector; sum of per-slot count/legacy/fallback and edge/scroll sub-totals checked.
negative_controls: LEFT captured versus RIGHT fallback not channel-paired
nonzero mask with zero press invalid
mask rollback in same epoch invalid
horizontal vector cannot claim independent horizontal-axis proof
next_step: On separate signed current full Raft game, compare one-process captured mouse press/release and wheel against original Unity getter channels and actual in-game response; do not count generic aggregate cooccurrence as gameplay. Preserve world/.rgd, keyboard, touch, camera and audio/Settings.
